method: Expert interaction checks with synthetic households, through the browser UI
checks: Reloaded an unsaved yesterday/dinner/ordered-in/pasta/adult-only meal: every field restored; Save added one scoped record; Riya history excluded it.
Opened a linked order draft, deliberately selected last year, reloaded the linked URL: the edited date stayed intact.
Started another log then opened an existing meal to edit: Resume/Discard choice protected the unfinished draft.
Added Riya to the adult meal: history count stayed unchanged and attribution became Asha, Riya.
Created a tiffin for Riya, edited it to Aarav: the same record displayed Aarav and edited, with unchanged meal count.
Marked bread bought, reloaded and hid bought items: the same planned need stayed fulfilled. Legacy carrot purchase also stayed fulfilled.
Corrected manual apples to green apples, 6 pieces; list showed the corrected item and quantity.
Reviewed 34 week suggestions, confirmed them, and verified Monday’s pre-existing menu stayed unchanged.
Excluded appam batter and beans, added the other 19 suggested ingredients, and verified the excluded ingredients remained in review.
Opened shopping from 25–31 Oct: that period showed no planned needs, while 26 items from other periods stayed separately collapsed.
Browsed Indian dinner dishes beyond forty, with 62 total and a Show more control; selected Rajma without searching.
Order in exposed Next and Previous, required mild preparation and a compatible browser; Record opened editable Log, without placing an order.
Actual GitHub-hosted recipient preview showed Riya’s milk instruction; changing the first recipe to an alternative retained it.
Cook handoff showed who/date/count, an allergy note and its primary action within the phone viewport; full message remained expandable.
Added a child through name/diet/allergy/school essentials and a fixed Save person; reload resumed setup and school details reopened with 15:30 pick-up.
Turned off all five optional home sections; Today kept Order in and Shopping, Memory kept Our food week. Original test-home preferences were then restored.
On 18 Oct, typing 19 Oct required confirmation of Sunday 19 October 2025. Explicit future days stayed unavailable.
Preview completed fresh setup and displayed version, cuisines, food-calendar master and AI walkthrough. Public checks are recorded separately with the final bundle identity.
limits: No physical Android/iPhone install or device screen-reader session
No real messages, orders, personal images or real AI keys used
No certification of recipe allergen metadata or translation accuracy
